name: Example Tag & Privacy Rules
description: Declarative rules demonstrating required-tag and cookie checks.
author: Pageguard

rules.title: Google Tag Manager is not installed
rules.description: The page does not load Google Tag Manager.
rules.remediation: Add the GTM container snippet to the document head.

rules.title: No consent management platform detected
rules.description: No recognised consent tool (e.g. OneTrust) was observed.
rules.remediation: Deploy a consent management platform before loading marketing tags.

rules.title: Cookie set without the Secure flag
rules.description: A first-party cookie was observed without the Secure attribute.
rules.remediation: Set the Secure attribute on all cookies.
